## Change

Describe the user-visible result and link the release record.

## Postprocessor compatibility

- [ ] App version is exactly one patch above current main; package.json and lockfile agree.
- [ ] docs/releases/<version>.json records compatibility and any breaking or potential breaking change.
- [ ] Schemas, capabilities, execution events, audit/output and installation/storage were checked.
- [ ] Legacy installed posts and saved revisions are preserved; required migrations or new packages are explained.
- [ ] Generated authoring docs and applicable fixtures were updated and verified.
- [ ] Validation evidence and any controller verification limitations are listed below.

## Validation

List commands and observed results. Do not claim machine verification from software tests.
